_notes.p1.organization: The logo is the relative IRI 'logo.png' on /docs/. JSON-LD resolves it against that page: /docs/logo.png (200), so 6. Before 1.3.0 the scorer joined it onto the scope root without a trailing slash (/logo.png, 404) and gave 5.
_notes._sampled: /docs-legacy is a sibling folder, not inside /docs. Before 1.3.0 a bare startswith('/docs') sampled it.
_notes._sample_source: discover() now tries /docs/sitemap.xml, the same fallback run() scores, so the sample comes from the sitemap it scored.
_notes._server_links: home_links 6, not 5, from 1.7.1: the start page /docs/ also links outside the scope, and a crawler follows a link anywhere on the host. 1.7.0 counted links inside the scope only, which read a run started at one page as having no links at all.
